family.description: This entry represents the catalytic C-terminal domain of the LpxI enzyme that is involved in biosynthesis of lipid A. Specifically it carried out the hydrolysis of UDP-2,3-diacyl- glucosamine. This step is either carried out by LpxI or LpxH [[cite:PUB00091500]]. This domain comprises a five-stranded mixed beta-sheet bracketed by one alpha-helix on one side and three on the other. This domain is structurally related to a superfamily that includes cytosine deaminase [[cite:PUB00091500]].
family.name: LpxI C-terminal domain
